definition: At every acquisition, minimum over constant baseline b of mean(w^2*(F-b-contact_force(E,c))^2) divided by measured approach force dynamic range squared. w=min(abs(z-c)/(2e-6m),1). Compare to attainable standard parameters under this same profiled physical objective.
reference_type: Attainable conditional contact-law fit, not measured modulus/contact truth
tolerance_provenance: Declared extra normalized force-MSE1e-6 per approach; equivalent0.1% range RMS fit budget, not calibrated noise.
